subject: Intro call recap & proposed next steps — VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.inc>, Sarah Liu <s.liu@acme.inc>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call recap & proposed next steps — VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive

Hi Daniel / Sarah —

Great speaking with you this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

1) What we heard (brief):
- Evaluating an LLM inference platform to replace current ad-hoc GPU endpoints — priority on predictable latency, lower token costs, and VPC isolation for regulated telemetry.
- Timing: target pilot with 1-2 prod features in Q3; procurement/contracting team engaged.

2) Qualification notes:
- Primary workload: conversational support + summarize-to-structured outputs (~1k reqs/min peak expected).
- Data residency: must stay within US regions; SOC2 + audit logs required.
- Decision stakeholders: CTO (Todd), VP Engineering (Daniel), Procurement (Sarah).

3) Proposed next steps to unblock:
- Technical deep-dive (60 min) with our Solutions Architect to validate architecture, latency SLOs, and KV-cache strategy.
- VP/CTO intro (15–20 min) to confirm executive alignment and procurement path.

Availability ask: can you share 2 x 60-min windows next week for the technical deep-dive, and 2 shorter windows for the VP/CTO intro? We can run the deep-dive as a remote screen-share; will include a short perf snapshot for your latency profile.

Attached: short outline deck (redwood-enterprise-outline.pdf) that maps features to the items we discussed.

Thanks — happy to coordinate calendar invites once you confirm windows.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment: redwood-enterprise-outline.pdf (3 pages)
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.inc>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liu <s.liu@acme.inc>, Todd Barnes <todd.barnes@acme.inc>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call recap & proposed next steps — VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive

Thanks Aisha — good summary. We appreciate the clear next steps. A couple quick notes:

- We'd like to include our Security lead (Todd is CTO; I can loop in Priya from Security if that helps) for a portion of the deep-dive — mostly around audit logs and KMS integration.
- For calendar availability (PST):
  * Tues 14 Apr 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
  * Wed 15 Apr 09:00–10:00

For the VP/CTO intro, short options:
  * Mon 13 Apr 16:00–16:20 or Tue 14 Apr 11:30–11:50

We have an internal procurement checkpoint on 21 Apr so getting these scheduled before then would be ideal.

Also, can you share a short checklist of the SOC2 artifacts you normally provide during onboarding so I can preview?

— Daniel
VP Engineering | Acme Manufacturing
O: (206) 555-4480
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.inc>, Sarah Liu <s.liu@acme.inc>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call recap & proposed next steps — VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive

Daniel — thanks for the quick reply and availability. We can absolutely include Priya (security) for the relevant portion. Sergio (cc'd) will lead the deep-dive and can speak to our KV-cache, batching, and VPC integration.

Proposed bookings based on your windows:
- Technical deep-dive: Tues 14 Apr 15:00–16:00 PT (Sergio + Solutions Eng + short perf demo)
- VP/CTO intro: Tues 14 Apr 11:30–11:50 PT (Aisha, Vivek, Todd)

I'll hold those internally and send invites pending your confirmation.

Regarding SOC2 artifacts: short checklist attached below (high level):
- SOC2 Type II report (summary)
- Data classification and retention policy
- KMS/HSM integration notes and encryption at rest details
- Audit log examples and retention windows

We can drop the detailed artifacts in a secure share after an NDA if needed.

-Vivek
Sr. Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

---
Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Solutions Architect — will cover perf and architecture during deep-dive
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.inc>

Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call recap & proposed next steps — VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive

All good — confirmed for both slots. I accepted the calendar invites. Priya (security) is on the invite for the deep-dive. Looking forward to the demo and the perf snapshot.

One ask for the agenda: can Sergio include a short section (10 min) showing how prefix caching would affect our 95th percentile latency at 1k reqs/min? That will help our SREs assess risk.

See you Tuesday.

Thanks,
Daniel
VP Engineering | Acme Manufacturing
